name: Rig Linter (Blender add-on: rig checks before Unreal/Unity/FBX export)
summary: Free Blender extension (v0.2.0) that checks an armature and its skinned meshes before export to Unreal, Unity or generic FBX: 19 checks (helper bones, multiple roots, weights not summing to 1, too many influences, unapplied scale, ngons, unit scale...), each with an explanation and a one-click fix for the safe ones. Ships with a demo character and a short manual.

access.notes: Download opens after entering an email (subscribes you to the Depth Pass Friday letter). Tested on Blender 5.2.3; not yet tested on Rigify/Auto-Rig Pro. Demo character by Quaternius (CC0).

procedure: Open the Rig Linter page on depthpass.com.
Enter your email (Friday letter signup); the download opens right away.
In Blender: Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions > Install from Disk, pick the zip.

verdict.why: Practical game-export helper for Blender riggers, GPL-3.0 per page; but gated behind a newsletter email, so files, license file and version could not be checked without subscribing.

image.alt: Rig Linter, free: a Depth Pass card with the Blender add-on panel listing rig problems before export.
